exposure: Crystalloid solution infusion rates (10 mL/kg/h and 20 mL/kg/h of lactated Ringer's solution)
outcome: Phenylephrine dosage requirement (ED50) for preventing spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension
cohort: Eighty healthy parturients undergoing elective cesarean delivery under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia were enrolled.
finding: A higher crystalloid co-loading rate significantly reduces prophylactic phenylephrine requirement for preventing spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension.
mod_finding: The study found that a higher crystalloid co-loading rate during combined spinal-epidural anesthesia for cesarean delivery significantly reduces prophylactic phenylephrine requirement.
